verdict: Cloudflare grew revenue 34% to $640M and cut its GAAP net loss to $23M — the operating loss was $62M, softened by $40M of interest income on its cash pile.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted net loss per share, vs -$0.11 a year ago

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: 13% of revenue; operating cash flow was $158M

kpis.label: Non-GAAP operating income
kpis.note: an 11% margin, vs a $62M GAAP operating loss

segments.name: Cloudflare platform
segments.note: One platform business: network services, security, and developer/AI tools sold mostly as subscriptions. Revenue up 34% YoY.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning customers; includes $42.824M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes, and $1.250M of amortization of acquired intangible assets.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new products (R&D); includes $49.501M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office (G&A); includes $30.988M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes, and $0.423M of acquisition-related and other expenses.

follow100Note: Cloudflare spends $42.45 of every $100 on selling — its go-to-market machine is the biggest single running cost.
otherDetail: Non-operating income of $41M net was $40M of interest income on Cloudflare's cash and securities, plus $3M of other income, minus $3M of interest expense (mostly amortization of debt issuance costs).
footerNote: Stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes totaled $127M in the quarter across all lines — the main gap between the GAAP loss and non-GAAP profit.

takeaways.title: Growth re-accelerated
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 34% to $640M, with current remaining performance obligations also up 34% YoY. Gross margin was 71.2%, down from 75.9% a year ago as network costs grew with traffic and AI workloads.

takeaways.title: The GAAP loss keeps shrinking
takeaways.text: The net loss narrowed to $23M from $38M a year ago. The $62M operating loss includes $127M of stock-based pay; excluding it and related items, non-GAAP operating income was $73M and non-GAAP net income $94M.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow margin improved
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $158M and free cash flow $84M, 13% of revenue versus 11% a year ago. Cash and available-for-sale securities stood at $4,164M at quarter end.
